datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule throughout 2022, classifying geographic areas by acute food insecurity phase. The spatial data was compiled into monthly GeoJSON and KML files representing the current food security situation across Haiti.
